description: A painted still life in warm, dark tones. A long, flexible tube coils in loops across a dark table, with a glowing orange tip at one end and a splayed bundle of glowing fibres at the other. Behind it sit a brass microscope, glassware and an open wooden case holding instruments. A metal optical eyepiece with knobs lies in the lower right. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the square.
